scope: Bounded actual native input-freshness and Windows lifecycle review; no claim of complete backend verification

findings.observed: Two isolated actual IFC fixtures had a genuine managed native PASS. Moving source geometry or enlarging a current route solid made fresh native checks FAIL, yet both old candidates were accepted at revision 2.
findings.correction: The parent now hashes every declared current and protected-baseline source/materialization input after transition derivation inside the acceptance transaction. Managed PASS publication repeats the physical input check after assurance construction.
validated_cases: Actual source geometry changed after native PASS: acceptance rejected without revision or event.
Actual materialized route geometry changed after native PASS: acceptance rejected without revision or event.
Genuine private native PASS followed by source mutation during parent assurance: no public report admission.
Unchanged actual native inputs: valid acceptance with complete hash receipt.
findings.boundary: Root and alias mappings are transaction-bound. Arbitrary external filesystem changes are not locked out atomically, and hashes do not rerun geometry. Original user files were never modified by the audit.

findings.observed_after_correction: The same native process race returned COMPLETED after 1.093 seconds only when the descendant marker already existed and the owned kernel job was empty.
findings.correction: Create the direct loaded CPython image suspended; assign and verify its exact owned Job Object before resuming. Count completion through kernel job accounting. A byte-checked private interpreter bridge avoids the Microsoft Store launcher broker and preserves a direct sys.executable for ordinary recursive launches.
validated_cases: All three recursive ordinary sys.executable processes use their actual loaded direct image.
All three simultaneous PIDs appear in the owned kernel job inventory.
Every process constructs an actual OCP box and IFC4 model.
ifcopenshell, cadquery-ocp, numpy, scipy, pydantic and psutil versions match the parent venv.
Every process imports the same frozen oma source path.
The job has zero active processes at completion.
findings.boundary: This is ordinary CreateProcess descendant lifecycle containment, not a security sandbox against arbitrary external brokers. The byte-checked local cache is not a hostile-user boundary. Private sys.prefix differs intentionally; original venv packages and original standard library are used. Parent interpreter preparation is not preemptible, with its deadline checked before launching a child.
